keyEvents.text: Goal! West Ham United 1, Wolverhampton Wanderers 0. Divine Mukasa (West Ham United) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Arne Engels.
Goal! West Ham United 2, Wolverhampton Wanderers 0. Jarrod Bowen (West Ham United) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom left corner.
